method.sampling: Last 20 merged PRs per repository after full closed-PR pagination and sorting by merged_at. No topic exclusions.
method.diff_basis: First parent of merge commit to merge commit; final integrated patch, not first submitted revision.
method.existing_feedback: Issue comments created AND updated before merge; final-head checks completed before merge; separate review timestamp limits.
method.hindsight_case: archfit#106 to #120: selected after reading fix; not a preventive success.
method.scope_limit: Short windows; largely one human owner plus bots. Not a year-long multi-team test.
